Title: How can I control multiple gate at once (qiskit)

```

```

```
sub = QuantumCircuit(16) sub.cx(12, 4) sub.ccx(12, 4, 5) sub.append(C3XGate(), [4, 12, 5, 6]) sub.append(C4XGate(), [4, 12, 5, 6, 7]) sub.cx(13, 5) sub.ccx(13, 5, 6) sub.append(C3XGate(), [13, 5, 6, 7]) sub.cx(14, 6) sub.ccx(14, 6, 7) sub.cx(15, 7)
```

```
control()
```

```
csub = sub.control(1) circ.compose(csub,[i] ,inplace = True)
```

```
csub = sub.control(1) circ.compose(csub,[i] ,inplace = True)
```

